title: Puppet Retell
shareTitle: Puppet Retell — Make Your Own Puppet Show
description: Choose two puppet stars, dress the cast, tell an original or classic story in your own voice, and replay the whole performance. Shows stay on this device.
learningGoals: Tell a story with a clear beginning, middle, and ending
Coordinate character movement, expression, and dialogue
interactionModel: two-puppet direct manipulation with large action buttons, optional guided story beats, local microphone recording, and on-device replay
feedbackModel: spoken stage directions, responsive rigged-puppet actions, story-beat prompts, local-save confirmation, and replay celebration

modes.title: Story Starters
modes.skill: telling a beginning, middle, and ending

privacy.recording: optional microphone audio plus puppet-action timeline
privacy.storage: IndexedDB on the current device only

credits: Original QLOBE Kids game art produced with GPT Image 2, Krea 2, and Qwen Image Layered; shared rigged QLOBE puppet cast; runtime voice uses Qwen-cloned clips when present with device speech fallback.
